activity.overview: Use Punnett squares to predict genotypes and phenotypes.

problems.prompt: In pea plants, purple flowers (P) are dominant to white (p). Cross Pp × Pp. What fraction of offspring will have white flowers?

Two tall plants produce 75 tall and 25 short offspring. What are the parents' genotypes? Explain.
